authorityBoundary: No calculation in this registry grants production recipe, safety, machine-control or universal setpoint authority.

entries.name: Pressure unit conversion with semantic pressure type
entries.scope: Unit conversion only. Hydraulic, specific-plastic, nozzle, runner, cavity and pack-command pressures remain distinct.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: No location-to-location or hydraulic-to-plastic conversion is inferred.

entries.name: Location-explicit measured plastic-side pressure difference
entries.scope: Arithmetic comparison of like-for-like actual plastic-side pressure signals tied to explicit locations and one comparison basis.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Hydraulic and command pressures are excluded; the difference is not automatically a pressure-loss coefficient, viscosity estimate, restriction diagnosis or causal attribution.

entries.name: Clamp separating-force screening estimate
entries.scope: Arithmetic separating-force screen; not automatically a required machine clamp setting.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not resolve spatial pressure gradients, mould/platen deflection, tie-bar imbalance or dynamic effects.

entries.name: Clamp separating-force range
entries.scope: Uncertainty-aware screening range using an explicitly supplied pressure range.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: No safety factor or machine rating is invented.

entries.name: Aggregate shot mass
entries.scope: Mass accounting only.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not establish usable machine shot capacity.

entries.name: Verified-basis shot-capacity utilisation
entries.scope: Capacity screen only after mass-basis equivalence is explicitly verified.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: No universal preferred barrel-utilisation percentage is supplied.

entries.name: Clamp-force capacity comparison
entries.scope: Capacity comparison only after the applicable engineering clamp requirement and exact-machine usable capacity are independently established.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not determine a machine clamp setpoint, preferred utilisation margin or mould/platen load distribution.

entries.name: Specific-plastic-pressure capacity comparison
entries.scope: Like-for-like plastic-side injection-pressure capacity screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Hydraulic pressure cannot be substituted without a verified machine conversion basis; cavity pressure demand is not predicted.

entries.name: Volumetric injection-flow capacity comparison
entries.scope: Like-for-like volumetric injection-capacity screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not infer melt-front velocity, gate shear rate, pressure loss or a preferred utilisation percentage.

entries.name: Plasticising-throughput capacity comparison
entries.scope: Grade/configuration-aware plasticising/recovery capacity screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Nominal catalogue plasticising output is not assumed to equal usable grade-specific recovery capability without a verified comparable basis.

entries.name: Mould-height range fit
entries.scope: Exact-identity geometric fit screen for mould height.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not prove installation, platen/load, tie-bar, ejector, nozzle, daylight or safety compatibility.

entries.name: Opening-stroke fit
entries.scope: Exact-identity opening-stroke capacity screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Required removal/action stroke must be established independently; no ejection, daylight or safety compatibility is inferred.

entries.name: Maximum-daylight fit
entries.scope: Exact-identity geometric daylight screen on one explicitly common datum/definition basis.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not substitute for opening-stroke, ejector, tie-bar or safety checks.

entries.name: Tie-bar clear-opening fit
entries.scope: Orientation-explicit tie-bar clear-opening geometric screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: No automatic mould rotation; hoses, manifolds, protrusions, handling path and ancillary hardware are excluded unless included in the entered envelope.

entries.name: Ejector-stroke fit
entries.scope: Exact-identity ejector-stroke screen.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not prove ejector force, pattern, coupling, timing or interference compatibility.

entries.name: Declared-axis machine suitability composition
entries.formula: FAIL dominates; otherwise UNKNOWN dominates; otherwise MARGINAL dominates; PASS only when every declared required axis passes
entries.scope: Composition of explicitly declared machine/mould suitability axes without inventing missing engineering meaning.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: PASS applies only to the declared axes and is not a universal declaration of safety, installability, validation or production readiness; unresolved required axes force UNKNOWN unless a known FAIL already dominates.

entries.name: Hydraulic diameter from area and wetted perimeter
entries.scope: Geometric characteristic for a fully wetted internal passage.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not by itself establish pressure loss, viscosity, shear stress or a recommended runner/gate size.

entries.name: Uniform channel geometric volume
entries.scope: Geometric volume accounting for one uniform flow-path segment.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Does not include junctions/transitions unless separately represented and does not model compressibility, packing or thermal expansion.

entries.name: Circular-channel apparent wall shear rate
inputs: volumetric flow through exact circular passage
entries.scope: Nominal geometric kinematic screen for a fully filled circular passage.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: No Rabinowitsch correction; does not calculate viscosity, shear stress, heating, pressure loss or a safe material/gate shear-rate limit.

entries.name: Pressure-loss modelling readiness
entries.formula: Readiness gate over exact material, rheology, thermal state, geometry, flow and pressure-location semantics
entries.scope: Fail-closed semantic gate before any quantitative feed-system pressure-loss model is attempted.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Readiness is not model validation; MFR/MFI alone is not accepted as complete injection-moulding rheology, pressure locations must be explicit, and no pressure loss is calculated.

entries.name: Fill-stage measured rate arithmetic
entries.formula: Q = V/t; m_dot = m/t; v_ram = stroke/t
entries.scope: Direct rate arithmetic over one explicitly matched fill interval.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Screw/ram speed is not melt-front velocity; no shear rate, viscosity or pressure loss is inferred.

entries.name: Average residence-time estimate
entries.scope: Steady-throughput average inventory/throughput estimate.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Not a residence-time distribution and does not represent stagnant/dead regions unless included in the supplied basis.

entries.name: Average residence time from shot/cycle throughput
entries.scope: Screening estimate for steady repeated cycling.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Purging, rejects, interruptions, hot-runner residence and recirculation are excluded unless separately represented.

entries.name: Relative cooling-time diffusion scaling
entries.scope: First-order relative comparison only under comparable thermal boundary/ejection conditions.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Not an absolute cooling predictor; crystallisation, thermal contact resistance, local geometry, circuit resistance and transient mould state can invalidate the scaling.

entries.name: Source-bound linear shrinkage compensation range
entries.formula: D_mould = D_target / (1 - S), where S = (D_mould - D_part) / D_mould
entries.scope: Arithmetic starting compensation using an explicit mould-referenced linear-shrinkage definition and a source-backed range.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: Not a released tool dimension and does not supply a generic polymer shrinkage constant; anisotropy, fibre orientation, pressure/thermal history, geometry, conditioning and tolerances remain outside this arithmetic.

entries.name: Repeatability-aware gate-seal plateau assessment
entries.formula: Compare adjacent repeated part-mass means against a user-supplied decision tolerance across at least three hold-time levels.
inputs: at least two part-mass replicates per level
entries.scope: Controlled-study analysis for one material/gate/mould/thermal state.
entries.uncertaintyBoundary: A mass plateau is evidence consistent with diminishing additional transfer, not universal proof of an exact physical gate-freeze instant.
